# 1.2.36 - the notice tile, the tray's width, the last of the audit

**Notices land on their tile.** popup.mjs placed the stack with an inline `top`
just under the clock - measured off the Despair rail and the HUD - so under the
theme the cards sat high over the glass and the map, and the curtain was recut
around them each time. Under Stained Glass the stack has no inline `top`; it
sits on the bottom-left tile, 16 px from the edge and 100 px up (scaled with
the screen). And the tile is always cut now, at the audit page's place and
size, so a notice arrives on glass that was already there instead of cutting
the corner open and closing it again. A taller stack grows the tile.

**The tray is 300 px.** It was 280, narrowed in 1.2.28 to clear the sidebar's
shard; the shard is cut around the tiles now and needs no such room. The
status strip above it is 300 too, as drawn.

**Leftovers.** The Despair pips scale with the screen (18 px at 100 %), so the
rail no longer stays the widest block on a tablet. The hour's two arrows are
the page's pips: a 26 px cut plate with a 14 px pixel arrow, the state colour
on its edge. The pixel "mask" glyph gets its own token; it was set to itself.
